markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (57%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Invasive · Careful review
Invasive carcinoma (22%) is in the 90% set [F1], with high-risk margin regions 1 and 4 [F7].

## Confidence
|Signal|Value|Reading|
|---|---|---|
|Top probabilities|Benign 57%, Invasive 22%, InSitu 21%, Normal 0%|No dominant single class|
|Conformal set|Benign, Invasive (90% coverage, n=132)|Cannot exclude invasive carcinoma|
|Reliability / OOD|96% reliability, 100% OOD, 12/12 kept [F6]|Unflagged quality; most atypical distance|
|CONCH–MUSK agreement|Agree with each other|Independent models share top choice|
|Similar cases|0/5 Benign [F5]; 5/5 InSitu (86%–88%)|Neighbors contradict benign call|

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 7, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (1.56, -0.39); 12/20 spot check [F2] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Below-typical (0.21, +0.33); 8/20 spot check [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Typical score (0.29, +0.33); unreliable 0/20 check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Low score (0.28, -0.19); unreliable 0/20 check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops risk beyond random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (+0.001 vs random, CI -0.009–0.006); uses unreliable normal lobules, mitoses, necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasion in regions 1 (99% risk) and 4 (97% risk) is diluted across this composite image.
- Lesion is in situ carcinoma (21%), matching all 5 nearest neighbors (86%–88% similarity).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 4, 0**: Highest risk (99%, 97%, 64%) at superior (430 um) and medial (215 um) margins.
2. **Regions 7, 9, 11**: Strongest duct-confined atypia driving benign call; matches InSitu neighbor BACH_0263.
3. **Regions 2, 3**: Check region 2 for validated pleomorphism (0.77) and region 3 for TILs.

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names Benign, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
